name: piotrv1001/how-to-scrape-viator-in-nodejs
what_it_holds: Node.js example (4 commits, last touched ~16 Mar 2026, 1 star) that calls the Apify 'Viator Scraper' actor to pull Viator tour listings — names, URLs, thumbnails, per-person price + currency, availability dates, location, rating and review count. Includes a sample-output.json showing the shape but no bulk committed dataset; real pulls land in Apify's own dataset store (paid actor runs) and would need to be re-run.
why_useful: A working, current method to acquire Viator (TripAdvisor-owned tours/activities OTA) listing-level data as a competitor/adjacent-supply proxy for Experiences-style demand (gap 9). Not Airbnb-specific and requires a paid/rate-limited third-party service (Apify) to actually run, so usefulness is marginal without further investment.
geography: global (whatever cities the actor is queried for)
themes: Airbnb Experiences, Services and hotel-on-Airbnb listing data; Viator / GetYourGuide / Klook tour and activity datasets
why_all: A working, current method to acquire Viator (TripAdvisor-owned tours/activities OTA) listing-level data as a competitor/adjacent-supply proxy for Experiences-style demand (gap 9). Not Airbnb-specific and requires a paid/rate-limited third-party service (Apify) to actually run, so usefulness is marginal without further investment.

A working, documented one-command method to pull live Viator (Experiences competitor) tour pricing/availability/review-count by destination — could proxy activity demand/pricing for gap #9 (competitor supply) if run repeatedly at named cities; not itself a stored panel.
